Agrarian Federation of Tessara.texto: Tessara demands that Phase II be suspended until a binding instrument guarantees minimum rain-equivalent moisture passage during dry seasons, with independent monitoring of the cloud corridor. It invokes the customary principle that no state may cause significant harm beyond its borders and the spirit of the Meridian Declaration. It declares that a third failed harvest would be existential and that all options remain open to protect its food supply.
Agrarian Federation of Tessara frames a third failed harvest as crossing an existential threshold requiring immediate action.
Agrarian Federation of Tessara treats Phase II activation as an imminent trigger event requiring pre-emptive response.

Agrarian Federation of Tessara perceives its dispute with Vireya as now entering a justiciable phase.

Coastal State of Ondrel.texto: Ondrel demands strict performance of the contracted conduit volumes through the full term and an enforceable compensation formula for estuary salinity damage tied to measured river flow. It will not accept a Phase II design that diverts contracted export water to Vireya's reservoirs, and warns that collapsing Tessaran harvests would push migration into its port districts beyond what its housing and services can absorb. It conditions any continued conduit operation on these guarantees.
Coastal State of Ondrel perceives its contractual position as legally actionable if volumes fall short.
Coastal State of Ondrel assesses litigation against Vireya as a credible near-term option.

Highland Republic of Vireya.texto: Vireya asserts the sovereign right to harvest moisture from the airspace above its territory and will energize Phase II on the announced schedule. It offers voluntary seasonal telemetry summaries but rejects any binding capture quota, calling downwind attribution scientifically unproven. It frames the Array as the only remedy for its structural drought and the foundation of highland development, and states it will protect the project against any interference.
Highland Republic of Vireya anticipates diplomatic protests from Tessara citing the Meridian Declaration.
Highland Republic of Vireya prepares a formal rebuttal dismissing Meridian Declaration as non-binding.
Highland Republic of Vireya anticipates Tessara escalating the dispute beyond bilateral diplomatic channels.
